title: Initial Release
description: JWT Faker plugin for generating and decoding test JWTs in Voiden.

Added: HMAC SHA algorithms: HS256, HS384, HS512, and unsigned tokens (none)
JSON Header and Payload editors with live syntax validation
Quick claim action buttons for exp, iat, and nbf timestamps
Live token decoder and split inspector
Custom claim template presets and manager
